title: Constructive Quantum Field Theory and Rigorous Statistical Mechanics via Operator Algebras and Probability Theory -- Guiding Principles and Research Perspectives
summary: We present a hierarchical viewpoint on the operator-algebraic formulation of quantum systems, in which $C^{*}$-algebras are responsible for the universal and intrinsic description, whereas von Neumann algebras provide the detailed account obtained after fixing a state compatible with the dynamics. From this standpoint, for bosonic many-body systems the resolvent algebra, rather than the Weyl algebra, is the natural object; in particular, its nuclearity, trivial center, and rich ideal structure faithfully reflect purely quantum-mechanical structures.
